subject: small chubby green dragon whelp with an orange belly, little bat wings and a long tail, standing on all fours
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: a cone of orange and yellow fire from the mouth

plan.source: Small dragon whelp on all fours facing right; head high, mouth closed; near forepaw slightly ahead; far wing half-open; tail curled behind. No items held.

frames.pose: Anticipation: torso rocks back, chest dips; head tucks, jaw parts; shoulders draw back; forepaws press; hindlegs crouch; wing tucks slightly; tail coils tighter behind.
frames.effect: Small orange/yellow glow gathers at the mouth.

frames.pose: Key: sharp lunge forward; chest up; head thrust right, jaw wide; forepaws braced straight; hips drive; wing flares; tail whips opposite.
frames.effect: Broad cone of orange/yellow fire blasts from mouth forward-right.

frames.pose: Follow-through: neck still extended but lowering; jaw open; torso settles forward; forepaws bend; wing easing inward; tail continues swing.
frames.effect: Longer cone from mouth, tapering with a few orange/yellow embers along it.

frames.pose: Recovery: torso rocks back toward neutral; head lifts, jaw closing; forepaws relax; hindlegs straighten; wing folds toward half-open; tail curls back.
frames.effect: Cone ceases; tiny orange/yellow puff and ember just before the mouth.
